question: Will Carlos Martin (Hajduk Split) score or assist vs HNK Gorica on Oct 31, 2026 (excl. extra time & penalties)?

model.prompt_context:

- "Yes": Wins if Carlos Martin (Hajduk Split) is officially credited with at least one goal or at least one assist during the Hajduk Split vs HNK Gorica HNL match that kicks off at 14:00 UTC on 2026-10-31, strictly after 2026-10-31T09:00:50Z and at or before 2026-10-31T22:00:00Z, excluding any goals or assists recorded during extra time or a penalty shootout.
- "No": Wins if Carlos Martin (Hajduk Split) is not credited with any goal or assist under the above conditions — including if he does not appear in the match.

Clarifications:
- An "assist" is defined as the final pass or touch credited to a player directly preceding a goal by a teammate, as recorded in the official match statistics. Only regulation time (90 minutes, including injury time added to each half) counts; extra time and penalty shootouts are explicitly excluded.
